name: Solar flare inbound
label: SPACE WEATHER
description: Charged particles are racing toward the spacecraft. Protect the instruments or trust your shielding.

choices.label: Keep observing
choices.detail: Retain science; radiation tests the computer.

name: Battery cell fault
label: POWER SYSTEM
description: A battery module is running hot. Isolate it now, or keep capacity online at a cost to reliability.

choices.label: Cycle the battery
choices.detail: Recover capacity; lose 10% science and 8% health.

name: Ground station offline
label: COMMUNICATIONS
description: Your next downlink window just disappeared. Buy time on a partner network or store and prioritize the data.

name: Debris conjunction
label: ORBITAL SAFETY
description: A tracked fragment will cross your orbit. A small burn avoids it but shortens your operating life.

choices.label: Turn edge-on and wait
choices.detail: Save fuel; accept a 16% health penalty.

name: Solar array damaged
label: APOLLO-13 EMERGENCY
description: An array hinge has failed. Power generation is down 40%. The mission now depends on the margin you designed in.

choices.label: Reorient the spacecraft
choices.detail: Recover part of the power; use fuel and lose 10% science.
